summary: Phase 3 (Edit Dialog Frequency Support) frontend testing on the Emissions page. Logged in as goyalsomil@hotmail.com, navigated to GHG Emissions > Scope 3, opened the edit dialog for an existing monthly record (Facility C, 2026-02, C4 - Upstream Transportation and Distribution / Diesel). Verified the new frequency badge UI, lock indicator, and conditional reporting-period rendering. Could NOT visually verify yearly-mode behavior or the list 'Y' badge because the test org has zero yearly records — all 11 Scope 3 rows are monthly (frequency_type defaulting/legacy 'monthly'). Code path for yearly rendering was reviewed and looks correct.

issues: Pre-existing React hydration error (carried over from iteration_66): '<span> cannot be a child of <option>/<select>' on the Facility <select> in the edit dialog (Emissions.js around line 4025-4035). Caused by ve-dynamic <span> wrappers injected inside native <option> elements. Non-blocking but pollutes console and is a hydration mismatch.

action_items: (Verification gap) Phase 3 yearly-mode UI (Annual Entry purple badge, read-only Reporting Year display, 'Y' badge in Scope 3 list at Emissions.js line 5874) could not be visually confirmed because the test org has no yearly emissions. Main agent should self-test by creating one yearly record via the Add Emission flow and re-opening the edit dialog + viewing the list row.
(Carry-over from iter_66) Fix the hydration warning about <span> nested inside native <option>/<select> on the Update Emission Record dialog.
critical_code_review_comments: Emissions.js (6426 lines) continues to exceed the 700-line guideline. The edit dialog Reporting Period section (lines 4128-4188) is well-structured but the file should be decomposed into smaller dialog/section components (EditEmissionDialog, ReportingPeriodSection, etc.) for maintainability.

Frequency lock logic relies solely on UI display (badge + lock icon) — the edit dialog never renders a frequency radio to disable, so visually it cannot be changed. However, frequency_type is also not sent in the update payload when only the badge is shown; ensure the backend update handler ignores/strips any incoming frequency_type to defend against API-level tampering (defense in depth).

Legacy default to 'monthly' (Emissions.js line 3123: `emission.frequency_type || 'monthly'`) is correct for forward compatibility. Confirmed the edit dialog opens cleanly for legacy records with no frequency_type field.
The 'Y' badge in the Scope 3 list (line 5874) uses fixed text 'Y' which is small (text-[9px]) — accessible label is provided via `title='Annual Entry'`, good. Consider adding aria-label too.

success_rate.frontend: Monthly edit path 100% verified; yearly edit path + list 'Y' badge unverified due to no yearly seed data.
